title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-draft
content:
Weekly engineering sync — Serving Runtime / Infra / Console (draft)

Meeting logistics:
- Time: Tue 10:00–10:45 PT
- Attendees (recurring): Maya Chen (owner), Evan Rivera, Priya Singh, Liam O'Connor, oncall rotation
- Objective: quick health check, surface blockers for next sprint, track action items and rollouts

Proposed agenda (45m total)
1) Quick metrics + highlights (5m) — Maya
   - p50/p95/p99 latency for text-gen (avg over last 24h): 48ms / 120ms / 320ms
   - Token throughput: 1.8M tokens/hr (hosted), Dedicated pool at 92% util
   - Error rate: 0.6%  (5xx + timeout) — small bump vs last week (0.4%)

2) Incidents / reliability (8m) — Evan
   - Incident summary: Sat 03:12 PT transient KV cache evictions causing 5–10% latency spike for 18m; root cause suspected preemption/GC interaction on spot nodes
   - Current status: mitigation applied (prefer non-preemptible for cache-heavy slices); testing patch in staging (PR 412)
   - Discussion points: longer-term solution (persistent disks vs migrating to dedicated slices?), impact on cost SLA

3) Rollouts & canaries (8m) — Priya
   - Canary of quantized-8 model variant (q8) ongoing for small customer cohort — no regression detected on eval prompts so far
   - Console rollout: UI toggle for model variants queued for next console release (target: Thu)
   - Need decision: hold canary for extra day if staging perf looks flaky — pair with infra team to verify

4) Console observability + tracing (6m) — Liam
   - New tracing hooks merged but not yet wired to frontend (work blocked by auth change)
   - Proposal: temporary debug endpoint for ops (low-risk) to validate traces end-to-end

5) Capacity planning & autoscale (6m) — open
   - Dedicated pool utilization trending up; recommend increasing reserved capacity by 10% for next billing cycle
   - Autoscale tuning: current cooldown 45s; proposal to lower to 30s for tail-latency improvement

6) Action items review & new assignments (8m) — Maya (capture in notes)
   - Review outstanding items from last week (see below)
   - Assign new owners and due dates

Outstanding action items (from previous meetings):
- Evan: complete postmortem for KV eviction incident and link to CON-1243 — due 2026-03-04 (in progress)
- Priya: run extended eval harness for q8 variant across 10k prompts — due 2026-03-03 (running, ETA today)
- Liam: finish auth change PR blocking tracing wiring — due 2026-03-05 (blocked by security review)
- Maya: follow up with infra finance on reserved capacity cost impact — due 2026-03-06 (todo)

New action items (this meeting):
- Evan + Priya: triage staging perf flakiness for q8 canary and decide whether to extend canary by 24h — owner: Evan; due: 2026-03-04
- Maya: schedule short sync with infra-costs for capacity proposal and send proposal to Eng Directors — owner: Maya; due: 2026-03-06
- Liam: implement temporary debug endpoint and provide access instructions for SRE — owner: Liam; due: 2026-03-05
- Priya: coordinate console toggle rollout and write short rollback plan — owner: Priya; due: 2026-03-05

Notes / discussion prompts (scratchpad)
- Cost vs reliability: if we move cache slices to non-preemptible nodes cost increases ~12% — is acceptable for SLAs? get stake-holder sign-off
- Autoscale cooldown change: need to simulate under synthetic spike workload to ensure no thrash on GPUs
- Tracing: ensure traces include model-version, quantization flag, and routing policy tag for easier regression correlation

Decisions made (to record)
- Keep q8 canary running but gate expanding cohort until staging perf issue triaged
- Apply prefer-non-preemptible policy for cache-heavy slices temporarily during peak hours (06:00–20:00 PT)

Misc / parking lot
- Follow-up: consolidation of rollout docs into single Confluence page (CON-1243) — Maya to own
- Longer term: investigate using persistent KV store for prefix cache (research note needed)

Meeting prep checklist (for owner)
- Pull last 24h metrics dash + any alerts (Maya)
- Ensure postmortem draft is available (Evan)
- Verify q8 eval run status (Priya)
- Confirm auth PR status and expected unblock (Liam)

Quick notes to self:
- If infra cost sign-off delayed, prepare fallback: staggered non-preemptible windows by customer tier
- Remember to sync with Console PM about UX for model-variant toggle (avoid leaking experimental flags to customers)

End of draft.

-- Maya
